## History

Christine Stuart spent a winter studying music in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) while attending social events alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Her frequent appearances with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) sparked rumors that bothered [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), including a widespread report that the two were engaged following their graduation. However, the rumor proved untrue when [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) ultimately clarified past misunderstandings and proposed to [Anne](../character/anne.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P2](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0002), [v3 ch.Christine P3](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0003), [v3 ch.Christine P5](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0005), [v3 ch.Christine P7](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0007), [v3 ch.Christine P8](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0008), [v3 ch.Christine P9](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0009), +58 more_

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/christine-stuart--gilbert-blythe.md)

Christine Stuart and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are college acquaintances during their time at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Their frequent public appearances together spark widespread rumors among their peers, including a reported engagement, which deeply affects [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). However, Gilbert's heart remains with [Anne](../character/anne.md), and he later clarifies his true feelings when he successfully proposes to [Anne](../character/anne.md) after graduation.
